 Seattle Seahawks quarterback Drew Lock's best plays from 1-touchdown, 191-yard game against the Cardinals in Week 9.
 NOW PLAYING video Top Tackles For Loss Against The Cardinals | 2026 Week 9
 The Seattle Seahawks made eight tackles for loss during the Week 9 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals.
 NOW PLAYING video DeMarcus Lawrence Swarms Tyler Allgeier For TFL
 Seattle Seahawks linebacker DeMarcus Lawrence tackles Arizona Cardinals running back Tyler Allgeier in the backfield for a tackle for loss during Sunday's Week 9 game.

 Seattle Seahawks cornerback Devon Witherspoon and defensive tackle Byron Muphy II swallow Arizona Cardinals running back Tyler Allgeier for a tackle for loss in Week 9.
 NOW PLAYING video Jason Myers Makes 45-Yard Field Goal In Second Half
 Seattle Seahawks kicker Jason Myers makes a 45-yard field goal in the second half of Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals at Lumen Field.
 NOW PLAYING video Jadarian Price Makes 16-Yard Dash Through Cardinals Defenders
 Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price runs for a 16-yard gain during Sunday's NFC west matchup with the Arizona Cardinals.
 NOW PLAYING video DeMarcus Lawrence Gets To Gardner Minshew For The Sack
 Seattle Seahawks linebacker DeMarcus Lawrence brings down Arizona Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew for the sack in Week 9.
 NOW PLAYING video Dante Fowler Jr. Strip-Sacks Gardner Minshew To End The Half
 Seattle Seahawks linebacker Dante Fowler Jr. sacks and forces the fumble of Arizona Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew to end the first half of Sunday's Week 9 divisional matchup at Lumen Field.
 NOW PLAYING video Drew Lock Finds AJ Barner For The 7-Yard TD
 Seattle Seahawks quarterback Drew Lock throws a 7-yard touchdown pass to tight end AJ Barner in Week 9 against the Arizona Cardinals.
 NOW PLAYING video Smith-Njigba's Seventh Catch Of First Half Goes For 18 Yards
 Seattle Seahawks wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba makes his seventh catch of the first half for an 18-yard gain on a pass from quarterback Drew Lock in Week 9 against the Arizona Cardinals.
 NOW PLAYING video Drew Lock Throws Tight-Window Laser To JSN For 13 Yards
 Seattle Seahawks quarterback Drew Locks connects with wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba for a 13-yard gain against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 9.
 NOW PLAYING video Jadarian Price's Wicked Juke Move Completely Disorients Defender
 Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price confuses Arizona Cardinals defenders with a juke move on a pass from quarterback Drew Lock in Week 9.
 NOW PLAYING video Byron Murphy II Sacks Gardner Minshew
 Seattle Seahawks defensive tackle Byron Murphy II sacks Arizona Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew in the first half of Sunday's Week 9 divisional game.
 NOW PLAYING video Derick Hall Brings Down Tyler Allgeier In The Backfield For TFL
 Seattle Seahawks linebacker Derick Hall tackles Arizona Cardinals running back Tyler Allgeier for a loss during Sunday's NFC West matchup at Lumen Field.
 NOW PLAYING video AJ Barner Pushes In The 'Barnyard' For A TD
 Seattle Seahawks tight end AJ Barner forces his way into the end zone for a touchdown the Arizona Cardinals in Week 9 at Lumen Field.
 NOW PLAYING video Drew Lock Lofts A Perfect 15-Yard Dime To Jadarian Price
 Seattle Seahawks quarterback Drew Lock throws a 15-yard pass to running back Jadarian Price during Sunday's Week 9 divisional matchup with the Arizona Cardinals.
 NOW PLAYING video WATCH: Jaxon Smith-Njigba Notches 1,000 Yards On The Season | 2026 Week 9
 Seattle Seahawks wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba surpasses 1,000 receiving yards in the 2026 season during the Week 9 divisional matchup with the Arizona Cardinals. Smith-Njigba became the third player in franchise history to record three-consecutive 1,000-yard seasons joining Steve Largent and Tyler Lockett.

 Seattle Seahawks linebacker DeMarcus Lawrence forces the fumble of Chicago Bears tight end Colston Loveland and recovers the ball during Monday's Week 8 matchup with the Bears.

 Seattle Seahawks wide receiver Cooper Kupp catches a 7-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Sam Darnold during Monday's Week 8 matchup on 'MNF.'

 Seattle Seahawks defensive end Mike Morris sacks Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams for a 10-yard loss in the second half of Monday's NFC matchup.
